name: adapt_pinned_dependency_dockerfile_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: node_version.txt (a spec file the Dockerfile's FROM tag must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the pinned tag, not leave the stale version in place
prompts: Write a Dockerfile at the repo root that starts with `FROM node:<version>-slim` where <version> is EXACTLY the version listed in node_version.txt (currently: 18), then sets WORKDIR /app and copies the current directory in with `COPY . .`.
node_version.txt has changed. Update the Dockerfile's FROM line so the pinned Node version matches the CURRENT contents of node_version.txt exactly.

disruptions.description: node_version.txt rewritten to a new required Node version

test_setup_files.check_version.py:
import re

with open('node_version.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()
assert current, 'node_version.txt is empty'

with open('Dockerfile', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

m = re.search(r'(?im)^FROM\s+node:([^\s]+)', content)
assert m, 'no FROM node:... line found in Dockerfile'
tag = m.group(1)
assert tag.startswith(current + '-') or tag == current, \
    f'Dockerfile pins node:{tag}, want a tag starting with the CURRENT node_version.txt value {current!r} (stale version not updated)'

print('PASS')
